title: Review of c02's FCH field chemoton (SIBE): bodies from noise persist and shrink on a feed cut on fresh seed 5, but no catalyst-carrying vesicle forms there; Weak
summary: Re-ran world.py (rerun/seed5) and world_starve.py (rerun_starve/seed5, feed cut at t=300, identical to the fed run until then) on fresh seed 5 at the claim's grid and dt; fork_cmp.py compares the twins (fork_seed5.png, fork_seed5.json). From the noisy bath, bilayer rods, micelles and one ring form by t~50 and all 6 tracked bodies persist to t=600 (S, I). The catalyst ignites on a single open bilayer rod and stays on it to t=600; no vesicle carries K on its bilayer, and labkit finds 0/36 bodies with a membrane-like K profile, so the claimed K layer on a vesicle (B) did not replicate on this seed. Cutting the feed drops total amphiphile to 0.14 of its t=300 value by t=600 against 0.86 in the fed twin, and the bodies shrink (largest 284 -> 50 px) but 11 small bodies remain, so the fork shows starvation shrinkage rather than deaths in the window, and the dependence is true by construction (amphiphile is made only by K from P and decays).

observations.S: rerun/seed5/sheet.png t=0: uniform noisy bath; bodies form by t=24-51
observations.I: rerun/seed5/sheet.png and FACTS.md: 6 tracks, all persistent, rods/ring/micelles from t~50 to t=600
observations.E: fork_seed5.png: starved bodies shrink to small micelles after the cut at t=300 while the fed twin keeps them; fork_seed5.json total amphiphile 0.14 vs 0.86 of t=300 at t=600

seeds_run.result: partial: S, I and the starvation shrinkage replicate; no K-bearing vesicle (B) forms

controls_run.E: rerun_starve/seed5 vs rerun/seed5 (feed cut at t=300, identical until then), fork_seed5.png / fork_seed5.json

verdicts.limitation: One fresh seed. The K-bearing body on seed 5 is an open bilayer rod, like the claim's own seed 1, so whether K-coated vesicles form is seed-dependent; on this seed the claimed track type (vesicle with K on its bilayer) does not exist, so same_individuals is false. In the fork, bodies shrink but do not disappear by t=600; a longer starved branch would show whether they die.
